description: The line plot illustrates the accuracy of three different models over a range of values from 0.91 to 0.98. The x-axis is labeled with the values 0.91, 0.92, 0.93, 0.94, 0.95, 0.96, 0.97, and 0.98, indicating a linear scale. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy" and ranges from 0.0 to 1.0, also on a linear scale. The first line, represented by a solid blue line with square markers, shows a slight increase in accuracy from 0.8 to 1.0. The second line, a dashed orange line with diamond markers, starts at an accuracy of 0.6 and decreases to 0.1. The third line, a dash-dot green line with triangle markers, begins at an accuracy of 0.2 and increases to 0.9. The plot includes error bars at each data point, indicating variability in the accuracy measurements.
